use_case: Student-success early-alert risk scoring: predicts which students may withdraw or fail a course so advisors can offer help
vendor_or_model: SIS vendor's student-success analytics module (predictive model; not generative), configured by the Director of Institutional Effectiveness
data_categories: LMS activity; attendance; grades; credits; account holds; age; home ZIP code; Pell eligibility and first-generation status from the ISIR (to be removed); outputs: risk score, band, top 3 factors (education records; customer information)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (routes supportive outreach); escalates to Education if used for admission, aid, standing, or placement
human_in_the_loop: Advisor reviews each flagged student and decides whether and how to reach out; overrides recorded; no automated action
applicable_laws: FERPA 34 CFR 99.31(a)(1) (school officials; vendor direct control); HEA sec. 483 limits on FAFSA data; FTC Safeguards Rule 16 CFR 314.4(f); Title VI; Title IX; Section 504; Age Discrimination Act; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Pilot (2 programs); approved with conditions 2026-08-21; no expansion until fairness thresholds pass

use_case: Admissions applicant scoring: ranks inquiries and applicants by predicted likelihood to enroll for admissions representative follow-up
vendor_or_model: Admissions CRM vendor's lead and applicant scoring feature (predictive model; not generative)
data_categories: Inquiry and application data; communications activity; applicant financial information for aid estimates
applicable_laws: Title VI; Title IX; Section 504; Age Discrimination Act; FERPA once admitted; FTC Safeguards Rule for applicant financial information; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Not approved 2026-08-21; feature kept disabled and checked after each CRM release
